npc.name: Hubert
npc.discription: Hubert, Your Roommate. He dosent leave the house much. Always working on his Austin Mini Cooper

dialogues.dialouge: I heard the General store has a 30% of sale this weekend... You can go if you want... I'll just... stay here... Im very busy.. Yes...

option.user_input: Why dont you come with me?

question.option: WHAT? I mean.. No thank you, im .. very busy doing... Dish washing... Oh hey, can you grab me some Red Spraypaint while your out? Its for a.. Project.. Thanks!

option.user_input: Alright, Im going there now, see you later

question.option: Ok. ill be.. here.. like i always am.. Oh also, could you grab me some Red Spraypaint while your out? Its for a.. Project.. Thanks!

npc.name: Robby
npc.discription: Robby, The General Store owner. Kind of Grumpy. Always walks Poppy, His Dog, down by the lake.
npc.dialouge: Welcome... We have 30% off everything if you want... Stop asking for more discounts.

npc.discription: Phil. Always at the pub. Dont leave your drink alone, He'll snatch it. Not very smart.
npc.dialouge: The sign at the front said Free drinks! 30 pints please! ... What do you mean there not free?! Where are my free Drinks!... Fine ill have a lemonade... ... 50 cents? You said they were Free!!"
